title: Krishiv analyze result, krishiv.analyze.v1
description: What Session::analyze returns as JSON (Analysis::to_json): a statement's class, the securables it needs, its output schema, column lineage and filter columns. Generated by `cargo xtask docs-analyze` from krishiv_plan::analyzer::lineage::schema. Additive within v1: members and enum values may be added, so a reader ignores members it does not know and accepts enum values it does not know; new alternatives of a `oneOf` (such as a new lineage leaf form) may be added too, so a reader skips an element that matches no alternative it knows and does not validate unknown forms strictly; `required` lists the members v1 has had from the start. The securables include the directories a run of DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE TABLE and INSERT checks (a managed table's directory for DROP TABLE and TRUNCATE TABLE when it exists, the table's location for INSERT), as they are at analysis and only when the statement's targets are allowed; not yet those of other DDL.

statement_class.description: The statement's class, as `system.queries.statement_class` shows it.

explain.description: How it explains, if it is an EXPLAIN.

partial.description: Whether the statement's reads are not fully known (then it is not provably read-only).

securables.description: What the statement needs, in first-use order: reads (with columns), then targets, then the directories a run also checks: MODIFY on a managed table's directory for DROP TABLE and TRUNCATE TABLE when it exists, MODIFY and CREATE on the table's location for INSERT (the qualified path as a denial names it, `file:` for a local one; the policy gets a local path with its links resolved), listed only when the statement's targets are allowed. Not listed yet: the directories of CREATE TABLE, CREATE TABLE AS SELECT, REPLACE TABLE, ALTER TABLE RENAME TO, DROP NAMESPACE CASCADE and partition DDL.

name.description: Its name parts (a path: its redacted text; a secret: its scope).

display.description: The securable as the 42501 denial text prints it (redacted by `Securable`'s `Display`, ADR 0038). A Krishiv addition, so a caller can show a requirement as a denial names it.

privilege.description: The privilege the statement needs on it.

columns.description: The columns its reads reference, sorted (empty for a target).

output_schema.description: The result columns: a query's analyzed output; for a write of one query (an INSERT of one query or a CREATE TABLE AS SELECT), the columns that query produces, not the target table's (the statement itself returns none); a SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN, SET or RESET command's result (RESET and SET PATH: none; an EXPLAIN gives no data schema of what it explains); empty for DDL, multi-table INSERT and other commands.

type_json.description: The type's lossless JSON (`DataType.json`: nested nullability, metadata), as a string.

lineage.description: Per output ordinal of a query (or of the one query an INSERT or CREATE TABLE AS SELECT writes), its sources and transform; else empty. For a write, ordinal i is the query's i-th column: the target column it lands in (a column list, BY NAME, its position after static partition values or defaults) is not given in v1.

sources.description: The leaves the value depends on, sorted.

via_view.description: The outermost expanded (temporary or INVOKER) view the leaf was read through, by its name parts.

path.description: Files read by path: the redacted path, as the 42501 denial prints it.

via_view.description: The outermost expanded (temporary or INVOKER) view the leaf was read through, by its name parts.

view.description: A view that is not expanded (a DEFINER view): its name parts; nothing under it is shown.

via_view.description: The outermost expanded (temporary or INVOKER) view the leaf was read through, by its name parts.

transform.description: The strongest step on any path.

filters.description: The columns that decide which rows or groups, sorted by kind in the listed order, then by leaf.

kind.description: Why the column decides which rows or groups.
